correctness.rationale: The exact Hilbert variance identity reduces ALL full-L2 Fréchet minimizers to arithmetic averages over three phase alignments; no finite Fourier ansatz assumption is needed. Orthogonal harmonics give norm-score [|Z|^2+u|W|^2]/9. At shifts (0,-pi/6,+pi/6), |Z|^2+u|W|^2=4+2sqrt3+4u>9 for u>(5-2sqrt3)/4, so c0 with F=u is suboptimal with gap >=(4u-5+2sqrt3)/9. At any global maximizer Z,W≠0; cyclicly permuting theta_j multiplies W by cube root of unity while Z unchanged, and W/Z^2 distinguishes three time-shift classes; Z≠0 makes their planar coordinate nondegenerate embeddings. At c0, each alignment has unique nondegenerate maximum cos(s); implicit-function theorem yields C2 Fréchet functional, with normal Hessian >=2(1-2u)>0 after removing orbit tangent; hence strict local minimum. Exact alternating update returns c0. Polynomial radial error rdot=r(1-r²) and graph error e_dot=-e yield orbital attraction and Floquet multipliers e^-4pi,e^-2pi. At u=.4 independent algebra gives score 9.064101615>9, gap .0071224 and normal curvature lower .4. Finite checks do not establish infinite-dimensional claims.
